Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for a native-pixel Godot side-view game.
Reference images are character identity and exact pixel style references, not backgrounds to preserve. Generate ONLY the same selected sniper B, facing RIGHT: slim light industrial exoskeleton soldier, dark graphite armor, worn olive yellow plates, orange eye/scope lights, long rifle, 32 native pixels standing height.
Create ONE transparent sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, EIGHT sequential STANDING RIFLE RAISE / AIM / FIRE poses in reading order. Desired canvas 1536x512, each equal cell 384x256, corresponding to 96x64 native pixels at 4x nearest-neighbor. Keep the same ground baseline y=228 within each cell, foot anchor x=192. A 32-native-pixel body is 128 image pixels tall. This is SMALL disciplined pixel art, hard square pixel blocks and a limited muted industrial palette.
Frame1: identical relaxed standing reference with rifle low. Frame2: both hands bring rifle up, weight shifts onto rear leg. Frame3: buttstock reaches shoulder. Frame4: steady shoulder aim horizontally right. Frame5: fired round with a very small warm muzzle flash, no projectile outside cell. Frame6: restrained shoulder recoil, knees absorb. Frame7: settle back onto both feet. Frame8: same stable shoulder aim as frame4.
Natural anatomy, clear connected limbs and rifle, grounded feet, constant body size, scope stays aligned. Strong silhouette. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha backdrop. No floor, no guides, no captions, no cell borders, no labels, no shadows outside sprite, no gradient, no anti-aliased illustration. Eight individual different poses only; never copy the full reference sheet. Preserve sniper identity, rifle proportions and pixel style.
